step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of a single-ended cascode Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) and a double-balanced Gilbert cell mixer. The LNA provides initial RF amplification, while the mixer downconverts the RF signal to an IF frequency using a differential LO.

lna_voltage_gain.description: Voltage gain of the cascode LNA at 2.4 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ≈ 195uA at Vgs=0.8V. Gm = 2*Id/Vov = 1.02mS. With 2kOhm load, Gain = Gm*Rload = 2.04 V/V = 6.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the chosen load resistor and bias current. 2kOhm load gives ~6 dB gain while keeping transistors in saturation.

mixer_conversion_gain.description: Voltage conversion gain of the double-balanced mixer (2.4 GHz RF to 800 MHz IF).

sky130_expected.calculation: Gc = (2/pi) * Gm * Rload. Gm = 1.02mS, Rload = 2kOhm. Gc = 0.636 * 1.02m * 2k = 1.3 V/V = 2.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Conversion gain is lower than LNA gain due to the 2/pi factor of the switching quad.

noise_figure.description: Noise figure of the LNA at 2.4 GHz with a 50 ohm source.

sky130_expected.calculation: NF = 10*log10(1 + gamma * gm * Rsrc). For short channel, gamma ~ 2. gm = 1.02mS. NF ~ 10*log10(1 + 2 * 1.02m * 50) = 10*log10(1.1) = 0.4 dB (intrinsic). With parasitics, ~3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The core LNA will have a lower NF than the entire receiver reported in the paper (6 dB).

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the LNA and Mixer cores.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Core power is a fraction of the total receiver power, which includes LO buffers and baseband filters.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure LNA voltage gain, LNA noise figure, mixer conversion gain, and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for LNA and Mixer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM3 N4 N5 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N13 VIN N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM7 VIF_P VLO_N N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM2 N6 VB1 N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 N1 N2 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VIF_P VLO_P N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VIF_N VLO_N N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM8 VIF_N VLO_P N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* LNA Input with 50 ohm source
Rsrc VIN_src VIN 50
VVIN VIN_src 0 DC 0.8 AC 1 SIN(0.8 0.01 2.4G 0 0)
VVB1 VB1 0 DC 1.4

* Ground connections for sources
VN8 N8 0 0
VN9 N9 0 0
VN12 N12 0 0

* Mixer RF Inputs
VRF_P N5 0 DC 0.8 SIN(0.8 0.01 2.4G 0 0)
VRF_N N2 0 DC 0.8 SIN(0.8 -0.01 2.4G 0 0)

* Mixer LO Inputs
VLO_P VLO_P 0 DC 1.4 SIN(1.4 0.4 1.6G 0 0)
VLO_N VLO_N 0 DC 1.4 SIN(1.4 -0.4 1.6G 0 0)

* Loads
RLNA N6 VDD 2k
RIFP VIF_P VDD 2k
RIFN VIF_N VDD 2k

* IF Filter Capacitors
CIFP VIF_P 0 100f
CIFN VIF_N 0 100f

* Behavioral source for differential IF
B1 IF_DIFF 0 V='V(VIF_P)-V(VIF_N)'

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point and Power
op
let total_current = -i(VVDD)
let power_mw = total_current * 1.8 * 1000
print power_mw

* 2. AC Analysis for LNA Gain
ac dec 10 100M 10G
meas ac lna_gain_2_4G find vdb(N6) at=2.4G
print lna_gain_2_4G

* 3. Noise Analysis for LNA
noise V(N6) VVIN dec 10 1G 3G
setplot noise1
meas noise inoise_2_4G find inoise_spectrum at=2.4G
let nf_db = 20 * log10(inoise_2_4G / 0.91e-9)
print nf_db

* 4. Transient Analysis for Mixer Conversion Gain
tran 10p 20n
meas tran if_max max V(IF_DIFF) from=10n to=20n
meas tran if_min min V(IF_DIFF) from=10n to=20n
let if_p2p = if_max - if_min
let if_amp = if_p2p / 2
let rf_amp = 0.02
let conv_gain = if_amp / rf_amp
let conv_gain_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain)
print conv_gain_db

quit
.endc
